apply_mp_style_corrections: apply Materials Project style energy corrections to an ASE Atoms object and return the corrected energy
generate_computed_structure_entry: generate a ComputedStructureEntry with MP2020 or OMat24 energy corrections applied to a pymatgen structure
generate_cse_parameters: generate parameters dictionary for a ComputedStructureEntry from a VASP input set including hubbard U values
create_OMat24Compatibility: create an OMat24Compatibility instance with Advanced GGA/GGA+U mixing scheme and custom config file
process_entry_with_OMat24: process a ComputedStructureEntry using OMat24Compatibility to apply energy corrections and clean the entry
